summary: Add a measurable lower-page balance check to the one-page layout guidance.
hypothesis: Repeated bottom-whitespace failures occur because the guidance requests hierarchy but does not set a final lower-page balance check.

patch.value:
## One-page layout QA

For a one-page resume, render the final artifact and inspect the page rather than trusting source-document layout. Keep the target role and strongest proof in the top third; use three to four distinct evidence-backed projects; and keep project bullets complete, readable, and proportionate. Maintain a small footer gap, but rebalance content or spacing when the lower page has conspicuous unused space. Treat lower-page balance as a final QA check rather than adding filler or reducing readability. Check for clipping, overlap, missing CJK glyphs, unreadable contact details, orphaned headings, and excessive bold density. Read [one-page-layout-qa.md](references/one-page-layout-qa.md) for the complete QA checklist.

expected_effect: Targets the logged lower-page whitespace failure without changing evidence or privacy rules.
